text:
li: hey all, accepted the GH invite but the org shows 404 and cloning fails. Using GitHub Desktop and the app just prompts for a token then fails with 403.
marta: did you accept with the right account? GitHub Desktop sometimes caches a different user.
li: I accepted via work account (li@redwood.ai). In the web UI I can see the org briefly then it says 'SAML SSO: authorization required' and shows a button that never appears in the app.
it-ops: onboarding checklist flagged: SSO authorization missing. Quick checks: 1) make sure you are signed into github.com in browser with work account, 2) visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood and click Authorize SSO, 3) re-open GitHub Desktop and sign out/in
li: I tried signing out of Desktop and signing back in as work account, still fails. Desktop asks for token and then I get 403 on push/pull. `gh auth status` on terminal shows SSO: NOT authorized.
marta: sometimes the SAML session is per-browser. Did you authorize SSO in the browser that Desktop opens for OAuth? Desktop opens an embedded browser that may block popups. Try copying the Authorize SSO URL and open it in your default browser.
li: ok open in default browser, clicked Authorize SSO, got redirected to Okta and approved. `gh auth status` now shows Authorized.
dev-bot: onboarding-bot: detected GH SSO authorized for li. Please restart GitHub Desktop to refresh cached tokens.
li: restarted Desktop and now I can clone over HTTPS. But SSH still fails with Permission denied (publickey) when I try `ssh -T git@github.com`.
it-ops: run `ssh-add -l` and ensure your key is loaded. GitHub Desktop can use its own SSH agent depending on settings. Also confirm that the SSH key is attached to your work account under Settings -> SSH and GPG keys.
li: `ssh-add -l` returns "The agent has no identities." I generated a new key yesterday but maybe added it to personal account by mistake.
marta: you can check which key is registered via your personal account. If it's on the wrong account, remove and re-add to the work account. If you want a quick workaround, switch Desktop to use HTTPS auth (token) for now.
li: moved the key from personal to work account and `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` then `ssh -T` returns the greeting. All good now. For future hires: note that GitHub Desktop embedded browser + cached personal sessions + SSH keys on multiple accounts can cause a multi-factor SSO loop. Incognito + browser-authorize + ensure SSH key on work account fixed it.
github-bot: tip: if you see "SAML SSO: authorization required" you must authorize SSO even if the invite says accepted.
li: thanks everyone, welcome notes super helpful. Logged steps in onboarding doc for docs team.
it-ops: thanks for filing the note, we'll add a short checklist entry about Desktop's embedded browser and SSH key mapping.
